Getting in: The entrance is on the island in the Swamp of Sorrows. Stonard is the nearest Horde flight point.
Kill Morphaz in the sunken temple of Atal'Hakkar, and return his blood to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood. The entrance to the sunken temple can be found in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Entrance: Ironforge (77.1, 51.3) (Forever client, our match: the only instance-portal model on the route)

Go into Ironforge and head for the throne room. Just before you reach it, a passage on the left leads down into the old halls under the city. Take the stairs and stay on the path down: you pass a quest giver, then a gnome further on, and the path ends at the entrance. There are spots where you can drop down to save time, but some of them land you in lava.

The Alcaz Prison dungeon entrance is located on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh, which is the northeastern island on the map. Players will find the keep on the north side of Alcaz Island after entering from the western side of the island. Once in the keep, the dungeon portal is located in the basement. Horde players should take the flight path to Brackenwall Village and proceed to head to the dungeon. If players do not have the flight path yet, their best option would be to enter from the Ratchet. Alternatively, players can also head south from Ratchet to Alcaz Island. Brackenwall Village Dungeon Entrance Alliance players should take the boat from Menethil Harbor to Theramore and proceed to make their way north to the dungeon. World of Warcraft: Forever releases with nine new dungeons, alongside every dungeon from Classic. This guide covers what each dungeon is, its level range, and where to find it. New and Existing Dungeon Levels in WoW: Forever

The nine new dungeons in Forever are all available on release, along with all previous dungeons from Classic. The new dungeons fill the gaps between the Classic level brackets, smoothing out the leveling process, with The Hall of Thanes and Ruins of Lordaeron both available before level 20. It counts as a Horde dungeon because only the Horde has quests for it, but Alliance players brave enough to cross the Horde capital can still run it for loot. Level Range: 15-25 Minimum Level: 10 Wailing Caverns is a network of caves in the heart of the Northern Barrens, named for the long, mournful wails of its steam fissures. The night elf druid Naralex hoped to use the caverns to restore the Barrens, but his link to the Emerald Dream became a nightmare that corrupted the caves and turned his acolytes into the Druids of the Fang. Wailing Caverns Strategy, Loot & Quests Guide Location The Barrens /way 45.5, 35.5 Dungeon Entrance The Deadmines Dungeon in WoW: Forever

Level Range: 18-23 Minimum Level: 10 Faction: Alliance Once the greatest gold mine in human lands, The Deadmines is now the base of the Defias Brotherhood, a group of former laborers turned brigands. Only the Alliance has quests here, but Horde players can still venture into Westfall and run it for loot. The entrance to Zul'Farrak is in Tanaris . Both factions typically fly in to Gadgetzan , then head west to Zul'Farrak. Entrance to Zul'Farrak As with many World of Warcraft Forever Dungeons, wiping (the entire group dying) in Zul'Farrak can be a frustrating time. Ideally, if the entire group is not dead, you should be able to get a rez (resurrection). This is a spell someone casts on you to bring your character back to life with a small amount of health and mana. Priests and Shamans learn this early; Paladins need to complete a quest to learn resurrection and may not have it. If you can't get a rez, click to release your spirit, then run back to the dungeon from the Spirit Healer (marked on the map below) as a ghost. You collect your body when you enter the instance.
